title: Is occupational therapy at Pinnacle only for children diagnosed with autism?
metaTitle: Inclusive Occupational Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Pinnacle Blooms Network extends its occupational therapy services to all children facing developmental or neurological challenges, not just those diagnosed with autism.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we believe in helping all children thrive. While our expertise lies in treating autism, our doors are also open to children facing other neurological and developmental challenges. Each child is unique, and we tailor our therapeutic strategies to meet their individual needs and help them reach their full potential.
